name: plus
description: One model for every node: maximum reasoning at the root, minimum effort on execution, the review gate kept at high.
notes: Same model as every other profile; what differs is the requested effort per tier and the fan-out width.
Execution runs at low effort: DSH's ladder is off | low | high | max, so the upstream 'medium' execution tier is expressed as low.
Choose this for well-specified work where the plan is more likely to be wrong than the typing.
